scope: Page-level float exclusion plan, multiple wrap floats at independent y, and mail-merge NEXT gate

layout.wrap: square/tight/through floats render at page start with per-float margin-top = y; two floats at y=100/300 measured at 197/397 (independent, not stacked)
layout.topAndBottom: blockFloatPlan inserts the block at min(y boundary, anchor item index), computes margin from current flow, and lets following text start below; y above anchor supported at an earlier block boundary

mailMergeNext.behavior: Gate: inserting Next Record shows ruleNextUnsupported and does not add the field; checkMergeErrors emits NEXT_RECORD_UNSUPPORTED for existing NEXT fields

remaining: A paragraph crossing a topAndBottom y is moved as a whole to the nearest block boundary; it is not split mid-paragraph
VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
